objective: Re-key `grove doctor` so explore checks run only on `grove-explore` registration, add two-registration drift detection plus stale-layout hint, and remove orphaned `--explore`/`--standard` flags conservatively.
key_changes: Re-key explore group trigger from `mode == McpLlm` to `grove-explore` registration in any selected harness.
Add registration-detection helper scanning all harness configs (Claude, Cursor, Codex, Gemini, Windsurf, VS Code).
Extend harness-consistency drift matrix for two-registration layout and stale single-registration layout.
Emit stale-layout hint to re-run `grove init --as mcp-llm` when old `--explore` arg is found.
Remove `--explore`/`--standard` flags from `grove doctor` and delete force plumbing in `cli/src/main.rs`.
Keep `ModeChoice::None` and `active_mode` in `core/src/config.rs`; only drop `ForceExplore`/`ForceStandard` variants.
Leave `core/src/lib.rs` and `cli/src/init.rs` untouched because the conservative path preserves their public API.
Remove `core/src/config.rs` unit tests covering the deleted force variants.
Update `core/src/doctor.rs` tests for registration gating, drift rows, and a non-Claude/multi-harness fixture.
Preserve structural checks, `--json` shape, exit-code gate, and mark the change material for version bump.
